Added to part 2a: the over-bound skip is recorded in the marker (skippedOverBound) and unrecorded rows carry grandfatheringSkipped; 'Do not delete the migration journal' (deleting it with plugin-trust.json re-grandfathers everything installed, including post-d1 bytes); and the writer-producible record rule (unsigned iff no signer, kontour needs Sigstore, tier 2 needs grandfathered or a Sigstore signer, grandfathered is tier 2, prior tier only on new decisions, no unchanged or operator values), with the same-bytes-reinstall publisher tier-2 case.
